subject: Pen test report sharing request — redaction boundary & limited exec summary proposal
messages:
From: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@vaultedge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test report + exec summary (NDA)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — VaultEdge is finalizing our vendor security review. Our security team needs a copy of the latest penetration test report and the executive summary so we can complete the SIG/SOC 2 evidence pack. We are happy to sign your standard NDA.

Two asks from us:
- Can we get a redacted executive summary suitable for non-technical stakeholders (PII removed, no raw exploit PoCs) first?
- For the full report, can Redwood provide it under a tighter NDA with a redaction matrix (we typically need: vuln id, high/critical classification, CVSS, remediation status, and whether an exploit was chained — but not hostnames or customer-identifying details)?

Also can you include current remediation status (open/triaged/fixed) and ETA for outstanding high/critical items? We need this by Sep 18 to stay on track for our Q4 security review.

Thanks,
Jorge
Jorge Alvarez
Head of Security Operations, VaultEdge
[Attachment: vaultedge_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@vaultedge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary (NDA)

Hi Jorge — appreciate the clear asks. Important to mention up front: we can share a redacted exec summary quickly; the full pen test report contains sensitive customer data and PoCs so we handle that under a controlled disclosure flow.

Plan proposal:
1) I will send a redacted executive summary (high-level findings, remediation status, risk ratings) within 48 hours under a standard mutual NDA.
2) For the full report, we require: a signed narrow NDA + review appointment (1-hour session) or an in-person review where our secops team screens for customer-identifying artifacts. We can prepare a redaction matrix that maps what we redact vs what remains (vuln id, CVSS, status, limited PoC abstracts).
3) We will provide a remediation snapshot (current statuses + owner + ETA) exported from our issue tracker.

Cc-ing Monica (security), Aditya (solutions), and Karthik (legal) to align on redaction scope and timeline.

Do you prefer DocuSign for the NDA? If yes, send the contact and we’ll push an envelope.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
AM, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Request: pen test report + exec summary (NDA)

Folks — forwarding Jorge’s ask and Tessa’s proposed approach. I reviewed the exec summary draft — it’s intentionally high-level but includes three critical issues (IDs A12, B03, C01) with status notes.

A few internal notes for the redaction matrix:
- Redact all customer hostnames, IPs, and proprietary config snippets.
- Keep vuln IDs (internal), but substitute any host-scoped IDs with generic resource tags (e.g., APP-123 -> APP-<redacted>).
- PoC: provide short descriptive abstracts (what the vuln allowed) but remove exploit code and step-by-step reproduction data.
- For chained exploits, we can indicate that a chain existed and its impact, but not reveal linked host identifiers.

Aditya — can you produce the remediation snapshot export (statuses + owners + target dates)? Karthik — can Legal push a narrow NDA template that permits evidence review but restricts further redistribution?

Monica
Director, Product Security 
Redwood Inference

Team — I reviewed VaultEdge’s standard mutual NDA and proposed limited edits. Key changes:
- Add explicit clause prohibiting redistribution of the full report to third parties.
- Define permitted recipients (VaultEdge security ops and their external auditor only).
- Require either a secure review session or use of our secure evidence room (screen-share w/ redaction toggle) for full report access.
- Add 90-day retention window for holding the full PDF on their side; after that they must request extension with justification.

I will send a DocuSign envelope with our narrow NDA template. Tessa — once Jorge signs, we can: deliver the redacted exec summary (today), upload the remediation CSV, and schedule the review for Sep 21 (proposed).

Karthik
